response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(tr.transreg) as type_count FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), aggregate_stats AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) as avg_count, SUM(type_count) as total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT COALESCE(tc.tradekind, 'No type') as trader_type, tc.type_count as count, CAST(tc.type_count AS REAL) / s.total_count as proportion, tc.type_count - s.avg_count as excess FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN aggregate_stats s WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND tc.type_count > s.avg_count
